entries.text: Welcome to the Artazon Gym! Would you like\nme to explain the rules of the Gym Test again?
entries.label: gym_kusa_020_receptionist_01

entries.text: The Gym Test here is [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Sunflora Hide-and-Seek[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]!
entries.label: gym_kusa_020_receptionist_02

entries.text: Find [VAR 0x0201(0001)] of the sunflower-shaped Pokémon\nSunflora throughout Artazon, then bring them\r\nto the Sunflora Lawn to pass the test.
entries.label: gym_kusa_020_receptionist_03

entries.text: You’ve gathered [VAR 0x0200(0001)] of them so far, so that means\nyou have [VAR 0x0201(0002)] left to find.
entries.label: gym_kusa_020_receptionist_04

entries.text: They may be hidden away up high or in other\nunexpected places, like around the backs of\r\nbuildings. Make sure to look all around!
entries.label: gym_kusa_020_receptionist_05

entries.text: Once you’ve gathered 10 Sunflora, please bring\nthem over to the Sunflora Lawn!

entries.text: Hi there! I look after the Artazon Gym’s Sunflora.
entries.label: gym_kusa_020_keeper_01

entries.text:
I hope you’re ready, challenger. It’s time for a
game of Sunflora Hide-and-Seek!\c
I’ll go ahead and ask the Sunflora to spread
themselves out around town!
entries.label: gym_kusa_020_keeper_06

entries.text: Flooora!
entries.label: gym_kusa_020_keeper_07

entries.text: Sounds like the Sunflora are ready for you!
entries.label: gym_kusa_020_keeper_09

entries.text: With that, your Gym Test has now begun!\c\nOnce you’ve found [VAR 0x0201(0001)] Sunflora, please bring\nthem back here to the Sunflora Lawn.
entries.label: gym_kusa_020_keeper_10

entries.text: That’s all from me, now! Good luck out there!
entries.label: gym_kusa_020_keeper_11

entries.text: It looks like you have [VAR 0x0201(0001)] Sunflora with you\nright now.
entries.label: gym_kusa_020_keeper_02

entries.text: Once you’ve found [VAR 0x0201(0002)] of them, please bring\nthem back here!
entries.label: gym_kusa_020_keeper_03

entries.text: Well done on finding all these Sunflora! You pass\nthe Gym Test with flying colors.
entries.label: gym_kusa_020_keeper_04

entries.text: Now, please head back to the lobby at the\nArtazon Gym to report your result.
entries.label: gym_kusa_020_keeper_05

entries.text: Would you like to take on the Gym Test again\nand seek out some Sunflora?

entries.text: If you leave Artazon, you’ll have to start Sunflora\nHide-and-Seek all over again next time.\r\nDo you still want to leave the town?
